latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Subtitle Extractor — extract and embed subtitles in videos via cloud rendering.

- Upload video files and generate subtitle-embedded videos or SRT/VTT files in 30–90 seconds.
- No timeline editing or export settings required — just describe your desired outcome.
- Automatic token/session setup with 100 free credits for new users.
- Supports common workflows: quick edits, batch processing, iterative refinement.
- Handles videos up to 500MB; outputs MP4, MOV, AVI, and more.
